title: RadPareto: evidence-aware resource comparison
description: RadPareto is a Python library and command-line workflow for checking comparison premises, screening supplied cost intervals against budgets, computing conditional Pareto sets, and reporting exact transition boundaries under a declared widening model. The source distribution contains reproducible analysis scripts, attributed published numerical inputs, licensed HDL examples, tests, and machine-readable validation outputs. Published numerical summaries are not raw hardware measurements, and cost comparisons do not establish radiation protection. Software is MIT licensed; reused numerical source material and external HDL retain the separate licenses and attribution documented alongside each dataset.
